status_zh: 理由由本项目手写，依据各子领域收录对象的尺寸与所用数据源能提供什么，未经导师确认。
status_en: The reasons are written by this project from the size of the objects each subdomain collects and what its data sources can supply. Not yet confirmed by the advisor.

absent.gloss_zh: 这个子领域的对象本身到不了这个尺度，所以这里不是缺口。
absent.gloss_en: Objects of this subdomain do not reach this scale, so the blank is not a gap.

elsewhere.gloss_zh: 这种题是有的，但按「一题一个叶子」的归属规则记在别的子领域，不在这一格重复计数。
elsewhere.gloss_en: Such questions exist but the one-leaf rule files them under another subdomain, so they are not counted twice here.

hard.gloss_zh: 对象在这个尺度上存在，但没有能由程序独立核验的几何问法。
hard.gloss_en: The object exists at this scale, but no geometric question that a checker could verify independently.

uncollected.gloss_zh: 这一格该有题，只是来源还没收集到或题还没出 —— 这才是真正的缺口。
uncollected.gloss_en: This cell should hold questions; the source has not been collected or the questions have not been written. These are the real gaps.

B1|10-100.name: 酶
B1|10-100.zh: 单个酶分子的最大原子间距一般在 10 nm 以内；更大的是复合体与分子机器，归 B8。
B1|10-100.en: A single enzyme spans within 10 nm; anything larger is a complex or machine and belongs to B8.

B2|10-100.name: 小型与调控蛋白
B2|10-100.zh: 按定义是小型与调控蛋白，跨度在 10 nm 以内。
B2|10-100.en: These are small and regulatory proteins by definition, spanning within 10 nm.

B3|10-100.name: 转运与储存蛋白
B3|10-100.zh: 这一格有意义是因为铁蛋白类载体（如 7DQO）的整体跨度就在这个尺度；但现有 B3 题问的都是配体口袋与配位，推理尺度落在 0.1–1 与 1–10 nm，整体跨度的题还没出。
B3|10-100.en: The cell is meaningful because a ferritin-type carrier such as 7DQO spans this range; but every B3 question so far asks about ligand pockets and coordination at 0.1-1 and 1-10 nm, and no whole-carrier question has been written.

B3|100-1000.name: 转运与储存蛋白
B3|100-1000.zh: 已收录的最大对象是铁蛋白类载体（如 7DQO），整体跨度仍在 100 nm 以内。
B3|100-1000.en: The largest object collected here is a ferritin-type carrier such as 7DQO, still within 100 nm overall.

B4|10-100.name: 膜蛋白
B4|10-100.zh: 单个通道、转运体与受体连同跨膜区在 10 nm 以内；更大的是膜片与囊泡，PDB 不提供这类坐标。
B4|10-100.en: A single channel, transporter or receptor with its transmembrane region stays within 10 nm; patches and vesicles are larger but PDB does not provide such coordinates.

B5|10-100.name: 毒素
B5|10-100.zh: 成孔毒素的完整寡聚孔道可以到这个尺度，但本子领域按单个毒素的作用方式（成孔 / 神经 / 酶类）选题，寡聚装置归 B8 大分子机器。
B5|10-100.en: A fully assembled pore can reach this scale, but this subdomain selects single toxins by mode of action; the oligomeric device is filed under B8.

B5|100-1000.name: 毒素
B5|100-1000.zh: 单个毒素分子远小于 100 nm。
B5|100-1000.en: A single toxin molecule is far below 100 nm.

B6|0.1-1.name: 病毒蛋白与衣壳
B6|0.1-1.zh: 衣壳蛋白内部的键长与二面角问题归 B2；本子领域的对象是整个衣壳，按 T 数选题，从 10 nm 起。
B6|0.1-1.en: Bond lengths and dihedrals inside a capsid protein are filed under B2; the object here is the whole capsid, selected by T number, from 10 nm up.

B6|1-10.name: 病毒蛋白与衣壳
B6|1-10.zh: 按 T 数收录的衣壳整体直径都在 10 nm 以上。
B6|1-10.en: Every capsid collected by T number is more than 10 nm across.

B7|100-1000.name: 核酸与核蛋白
B7|100-1000.zh: 收录的 A / B / Z-DNA、tRNA、核酶与核小体结构在 100 nm 以内；更长的 DNA 折纸归 C7。
B7|100-1000.en: The A/B/Z-DNA, tRNA, ribozyme and nucleosome structures collected here stay below 100 nm; longer DNA origami belongs to C7.

B8|1-10.name: 大分子机器
B8|1-10.zh: 枚举器估计这一格能出约 4000 道（多数机器的整体跨度就在 1–10 nm），但现有 B8 题的推理尺度都落在 0.1–1 nm（单个二面角、键长、二硫键筛选）与 10–100 nm（整机），中间这一格还没出题。这是目前枚举能力与已出题目差得最远的一格。
B8|1-10.en: The enumerator estimates about 4000 questions here, since most machines span 1-10 nm, yet every B8 question so far reasons at 0.1-1 nm (single dihedrals, bond lengths, disulfide screens) or at 10-100 nm (the whole machine). This is the widest gap between enumerable capacity and questions written.

B8|100-1000.name: 大分子机器
B8|100-1000.zh: PDB 与 EMDB 里的完整分子机器在 100 nm 以内。
B8|100-1000.en: Complete molecular machines in PDB and EMDB stay below 100 nm.

B9|10-100.name: 免疫与识别
B9|10-100.zh: 这一格有意义是因为完整免疫复合物（12E8 10.7 nm、1HHK 12.9 nm）的整体跨度到了这里；但现有 B9 题问的都是结合界面与抗原决定簇，推理尺度落在 0.1–1 与 1–10 nm。
B9|10-100.en: The cell is meaningful because complete immune complexes reach it (12E8 at 10.7 nm, 1HHK at 12.9 nm); but every B9 question so far asks about binding interfaces and epitopes, reasoning at 0.1-1 and 1-10 nm.

B9|100-1000.name: 免疫与识别
B9|100-1000.zh: 最大的完整免疫复合物（如 1HHK，12.9 nm）也远小于 100 nm。
B9|100-1000.en: Even the largest complete immune complex collected here (1HHK, 12.9 nm) is far below 100 nm.

C1|10-100.name: 有机化学
C1|10-100.zh: 单个有机小分子的最大原子间距在 2 nm 以内（QM7-X、QM9、PubChem3D 收录的就是这类分子）；更大的链与组装体归 C6 或 M6。
C1|10-100.en: A single small organic molecule spans under 2 nm, which is what QM7-X, QM9 and PubChem3D contain; longer chains and assemblies go to C6 or M6.

C2|10-100.name: 物理与量子化学
C2|10-100.zh: 量子化学数据集（QM7-X、OE62、GEOM、ANI-1x）里最大的分子跨度不到 2 nm。
C2|10-100.en: The largest molecules in the quantum-chemistry sets used here (QM7-X, OE62, GEOM, ANI-1x) span less than 2 nm.

C3|10-100.name: 无机与配位化学
C3|10-100.zh: 单核与多核配合物的跨度在 2 nm 以内；更大的框架与组装体归 M4 多孔与框架材料或 M6。
C3|10-100.en: Mono- and polynuclear complexes span under 2 nm; larger frameworks and assemblies belong to M4 or M6.

C4|10-100.name: 超分子化学
C4|10-100.zh: 主客体复合物（环糊精、柱芳烃、葫芦脲、杯芳烃）连同客体的跨度在 2 nm 以内。
C4|10-100.en: A host-guest complex (cyclodextrin, pillararene, cucurbituril, calixarene) with its guest spans under 2 nm.

C5|1-10.name: 反应与催化
C5|1-10.zh: 反应路径的几何变化集中在 0.1–1 nm；这个尺度上要问的是大底物或酶腔里的路径，Transition1x 这类数据集不给这种体系，也没有能独立核验的问法。
C5|1-10.en: Geometry change along a path is concentrated at 0.1-1 nm. At this scale the question would concern a large substrate or an enzyme cavity, which datasets like Transition1x do not cover and for which no independently checkable question is available.

C5|10-100.name: 反应与催化
C5|10-100.zh: 反应坐标上的几何变化发生在成键与断键的原子附近，10 nm 以上没有本子领域的对象。
C5|10-100.en: Geometry change along a reaction coordinate happens around the atoms that make and break bonds; there is no object of this subdomain above 10 nm.

C6|10-100.name: 高分子化学
C6|10-100.zh: 要有聚合物链构象或片晶周期的论文数值，还没收集。
C6|10-100.en: Needs published chain-conformation or lamellar-period numbers; not collected yet.

C7|0.1-1.name: 化学生物学与 DNA 纳米技术
C7|0.1-1.zh: 单个碱基对、糖环与键长问题归 B7 核酸与核蛋白；本子领域从 1 nm 起，问 DNA 纳米结构与药物–靶标体系。
C7|0.1-1.en: Single base pairs, sugar rings and bond lengths are filed under B7. This subdomain starts at 1 nm and asks about DNA nanostructures and drug-target systems.

C7|100-1000.name: 化学生物学与 DNA 纳米技术
C7|100-1000.zh: DNA 折纸的整体尺寸就在这个尺度，但 PDB 里没有完整折纸的坐标。能做的只有从论文里找证据出证据题，没做。
C7|100-1000.en: Whole DNA origami sits at this scale, but PDB holds no complete origami coordinates. The only route is evidence questions drawn from papers, not yet written.

C8|0.1-1.name: 液晶与胶体化学
C8|0.1-1.zh: 液晶分子与胶体粒子本身的分子几何归 C1 / C2；本子领域问的是相的周期（螺距、胶体晶格）。
C8|0.1-1.en: The molecular geometry of a mesogen or a colloid particle belongs to C1/C2; this subdomain asks about the period of the phase (pitch, colloidal lattice).

C8|1-10.name: 液晶与胶体化学
C8|1-10.zh: 胆甾相螺距与胶体晶格周期都在 10 nm 以上，1–10 nm 上没有本子领域的特征长度。
C8|1-10.en: Cholesteric pitches and colloidal lattice periods are all above 10 nm; this subdomain has no characteristic length at 1-10 nm.

C8|10-100.name: 液晶与胶体化学
C8|10-100.zh: 短螺距胆甾相与小周期胶体晶格落在这个尺度，现有 C8 题都在 100–1000 nm，这一格还没出题。
C8|10-100.en: Short cholesteric pitches and small colloidal lattices fall here; every C8 question so far sits at 100-1000 nm and this cell has none.

M1|1-10.name: 金属与合金
M1|1-10.zh: 合金超结构与长周期堆垛落在这个尺度，枚举器估计还能出约 4 道，还没选题。
M1|1-10.en: Alloy superstructures and long-period stacking fall here; the enumerator estimates about 4 more questions, none selected yet.

M1|10-100.name: 金属与合金
M1|10-100.zh: 本子领域的对象是晶胞与近邻配位壳层，几何在 1 nm 以内；10 nm 以上要靠晶粒与织构数据，COD 不提供这类坐标。
M1|10-100.en: The objects here are unit cells and near-neighbour shells, within 1 nm. Above 10 nm one would need grain and texture data, which COD does not provide.

M2|10-100.name: 陶瓷与氧化物
M2|10-100.zh: 结构原型（岩盐、萤石、刚玉、钙钛矿、尖晶石）由晶胞定义，几何在 1 nm 以内；更大尺度只是晶体的宏观尺寸。
M2|10-100.en: Structure prototypes (rock salt, fluorite, corundum, perovskite, spinel) are defined by the unit cell, within 1 nm; larger scales are just the macroscopic size of the crystal.

M3|10-100.name: 半导体
M3|10-100.zh: 半导体按族选题，对象是晶胞与键长；10 nm 以上是器件与薄膜结构，不在 COD 的坐标数据里。
M3|10-100.en: Semiconductors are selected by group, and the objects are unit cells and bond lengths; above 10 nm one is describing devices and films, which are not in COD coordinates.

M4|10-100.name: 多孔与框架材料
M4|10-100.zh: MOF 与沸石的孔径和拓扑单元由晶胞参数给出，在 10 nm 以内（CoRE MOF、IZA）；更大的只是晶粒尺寸。
M4|10-100.en: Pore sizes and topological units of MOFs and zeolites come from unit-cell parameters, within 10 nm (CoRE MOF, IZA); anything larger is crystallite size.

M5|10-100.name: 有机与高分子材料
M5|10-100.zh: 有机半导体薄膜与聚合物晶体的层周期落在这个尺度，还没收集到可核验的来源。
M5|10-100.en: Layer periods of organic-semiconductor films and polymer crystals fall here; no checkable source has been collected.

M5|100-1000.name: 有机与高分子材料
M5|100-1000.zh: 药物多晶型、有机半导体与聚合物晶体的结构单元在 100 nm 以内。
M5|100-1000.en: The structural units of drug polymorphs, organic semiconductors and polymer crystals stay below 100 nm.

M6|0.1-1.name: 纳米材料与组装
M6|0.1-1.zh: 组装单元内部的键长归它自己的化学子领域；本子领域问的是组装体的格点与周期，从 1 nm 起。
M6|0.1-1.en: Bond lengths inside a building block belong to its own chemistry subdomain; this one asks about the lattice and period of the assembly, from 1 nm up.

M6|1-10.name: 纳米材料与组装
M6|1-10.zh: 小粒径纳米晶的组装格点就在这个尺度，但同样没有公开的原子级实测坐标。M6 目前一道题都没有；能做的只有从论文里找证据出证据题，没做。
M6|1-10.en: Assembly lattices of small nanocrystals sit at this scale, but again no public measured atomic coordinates exist. M6 has no questions at all at present; the only route left is evidence questions drawn from papers, not yet written.

M6|10-100.name: 纳米材料与组装
M6|10-100.zh: 纳米颗粒超晶格的晶格常数就在这个尺度，但论文只给 SAXS 测出的参数，不给原子坐标。原来这一格的 10 道题，用的是按这些参数自己生成的晶格，已经拿掉（2026-11-11 起题库不收本项目自己生成的坐标）。还可以从论文里找证据出证据题，没做。
M6|10-100.en: Nanoparticle superlattice constants sit at this scale, but papers give the SAXS-derived parameters, not atomic coordinates. The ten questions this cell had used lattices generated from those parameters and have been withdrawn (since 2026-11-11 the bank takes no coordinates generated by this project). Evidence questions drawn from papers remain possible and have not been written.

M6|100-1000.name: 纳米材料与组装
M6|100-1000.zh: 大周期超晶格与蛋白石结构落在这个尺度，还没收集到来源。
M6|100-1000.en: Large-period superlattices and opal structures fall here; no source collected yet.

M7|10-100.name: 表面与界面
M7|10-100.zh: 切面模型题给出的是晶面指数与层间距，都在 1 nm 量级；更大尺度的表面形貌不是按明确规则切出来的模型。
M7|10-100.en: A cut-surface model question states Miller indices and interlayer spacings, of order 1 nm; surface morphology at larger scales is not a model cut by a stated rule.

M8|10-100.name: 生物与仿生材料
M8|10-100.zh: 矿化层与仿生层状结构的层周期落在这个尺度，还没收集到可核验的数值。
M8|10-100.en: Layer periods of mineralised and bioinspired laminates fall here; no checkable numbers collected yet.

M8|100-1000.name: 生物与仿生材料
M8|100-1000.zh: 矿化与蛋白基材料的结构单元在 100 nm 以内；更大的是材料的宏观形貌，没有原子坐标。
M8|100-1000.en: The structural units of mineralised and protein-based materials stay below 100 nm; larger features are macroscopic morphology with no atomic coordinates.

P1|1-10.name: 超导
P1|1-10.zh: 超结构调制与超晶胞的周期落在这个尺度，枚举器估计还能出约 4 道，只是还没选题。
P1|1-10.en: Superstructure modulations and supercells fall at this scale; the enumerator estimates about 4 more questions are available, but none has been selected yet.

P1|10-100.name: 超导
P1|10-100.zh: 磁通格子和畴结构的特征长度在这个尺度，但实验给的是图像和参数，不是原子坐标。能做的只有从论文里找证据出证据题，没做。
P1|10-100.en: Flux lattices and domain structures have their characteristic lengths here, but experiments give images and parameters, not atomic coordinates. The only route is evidence questions drawn from papers, not yet written.

P2|100-1000.name: 磁性
P2|100-1000.zh: 要有磁畴或磁泡周期的论文数值，还没收集。
P2|100-1000.en: Needs published magnetic-domain or bubble periods; not collected yet.

P3|100-1000.name: 二维材料与莫尔物理
P3|100-1000.zh: 莫尔周期约等于晶格常数除以转角：石墨烯 0.246 nm、转角 0.1° 时已是 140 nm 量级，再大需要近乎零转角的样品，不在本子领域按转角选题的范围里。
P3|100-1000.en: A moire period is about the lattice constant over the twist angle: 0.246 nm at 0.1 deg is already of order 140 nm, and anything larger needs a near-zero twist, outside what this subdomain selects by twist angle.

P4|0.1-1.name: 纳米与介观物理
P4|0.1-1.zh: 纳米结构内部的键长与配位问题按对象的化学归属记在 C1–C3 或 M1–M5；本子领域从 1 nm 起，按维度（零维 / 一维）选题。
P4|0.1-1.en: Bond lengths inside a nanostructure are filed under its chemistry (C1-C3, M1-M5). This subdomain starts at 1 nm and selects by dimensionality.

P4|1-10.name: 纳米与介观物理
P4|1-10.zh: 量子点和纳米线的尺寸就落在这个尺度，但公开数据库里没有它们的原子级实测坐标。原来这一格的 5 道题，用的是按论文参数自己生成的结构，已经拿掉（2026-11-11 起题库不收本项目自己生成的坐标）。还可以从论文里找证据出证据题，没做。
P4|1-10.en: Quantum dots and nanowires sit at this scale, but no public database holds measured atomic coordinates for them. The five questions this cell had used structures generated from published parameters and have been withdrawn (since 2026-11-11 the bank takes no coordinates generated by this project). Evidence questions drawn from papers remain possible and have not been written.

P4|10-100.name: 纳米与介观物理
P4|10-100.zh: 量子点阵列间距和纳米线长度就在这个尺度，但没有公开的原子级实测坐标。能做的只有从论文里找证据出证据题，没做。
P4|10-100.en: Quantum-dot array spacings and nanowire lengths sit at this scale, but no public measured atomic coordinates exist. The only route is evidence questions drawn from papers, not yet written.

P4|100-1000.name: 纳米与介观物理
P4|100-1000.zh: 收录的零维与一维体系（量子点、纳米管与纳米线的截面）特征长度在 100 nm 以内；更大的阵列是组装体，归 M6。
P4|100-1000.en: The zero- and one-dimensional objects collected here (dots, tube and wire cross-sections) stay below 100 nm; larger arrays are assemblies and belong to M6.

P5|10-100.name: 原子与分子物理
P5|10-100.zh: 小分子、转子与团簇的最大原子间距在 1 nm 量级，10 nm 以上没有本子领域的对象。
P5|10-100.en: Small molecules, rotors and clusters span of order 1 nm; there is no object of this subdomain above 10 nm.

P5|100-1000.name: 原子与分子物理
P5|100-1000.zh: 同上：QM7-X 几何与 CCCBDB 光谱常数描述的都是单个小分子。
P5|100-1000.en: Same reason: QM7-X geometries and CCCBDB spectroscopic constants both describe single small molecules.

P6|0.1-1.name: 光子学
P6|0.1-1.zh: 光子结构的构成材料本身的晶体学问题归 M2 / M3；本子领域问的是结构周期。
P6|0.1-1.en: The crystallography of the material a photonic structure is made of belongs to M2/M3; this subdomain asks about the structural period.

P6|1-10.name: 光子学
P6|1-10.zh: 胶体晶体、反蛋白石与超表面的周期必须与可见光波长相当，1–10 nm 上没有它们的特征长度。
P6|1-10.en: Colloidal crystals, inverse opals and metasurfaces need periods comparable to visible wavelengths; they have no characteristic length at 1-10 nm.

P6|10-100.name: 光子学
P6|10-100.zh: 同上：周期低于 100 nm 就落在可见光波段以下，不是本子领域收录的光子结构。
P6|10-100.en: Same reason: a period below 100 nm falls short of the visible band and is not a photonic structure collected here.

P7|0.1-1.name: 软物质与生物物理
P7|0.1-1.zh: 单个键长与二面角按对象归化学或生物子领域；本子领域从 1 nm 起，按体系（胶体 / 聚合物 / 膜）选题。
P7|0.1-1.en: Single bond lengths and dihedrals are filed under the chemistry or biology subdomain of the object. This one starts at 1 nm and selects by system (colloid, polymer, membrane).

P7|1-10.name: 软物质与生物物理
P7|1-10.zh: P7 整个子领域目前 0 道：胶体、聚合物与膜三类来源都还没收集。
P7|1-10.en: P7 holds no questions at all yet: no colloid, polymer or membrane sources have been collected.
